verdict.reason: Verified independently: `Sheet.undo` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:5306-5333) and `Sheet.redo` (:5338-5365) reload dimensions/styles/merges/freeze/hidden/filter/pivot and reset selection, but never call `clearCopyBuffer()`. A repo-wide grep for `clearCopyBuffer|copyBuffer` shows the only clearing sites are `shiftCells` (sheet.ts:1345), `moveCells` (sheet.ts:1562), the cut one-shot (sheet.ts:2381) and the Escape key handler (view/worksheet.ts:5118); `invalidateCrossSheetCache` (sheet.ts:3412-3414) only nulls a formula cache, so it is not an indirect clear. Neither caller of undo/redo clears it either — the keymap (view/worksheet.ts:5092, 5106) and the public API (view/spreadsheet.ts:649-666, used by frontend/src/components/formatting-toolbar.tsx:218) only re-render. Undo really does renumber cells: the production store's undo/redo (frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:1212-1238) replay `doc.history.undo()/redo()`, reversing structural ops, while `paste` (sheet.ts:2331-2374) still takes the internal path on a clipboard-text match and now re-creates merged blocks from the stale snapshot. The reviewer's example ordering is slightly off (a structural edit made after the copy already clears via sheet.ts:1345), but the reachable ordering "insert row -> copy -> Cmd+Z" (and its redo twin) violates the invariant documented at sheet.ts:2216-2222, and the diff's removal of the paste-time clear makes the stale buffer outlive the gesture. Blast-radius lane: an invariant asserted by the changed code is violated at an unchanged site the diff does not show; impact is wrong relocation of values plus spurious merged blocks, i.e. major.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. The remote path is exactly as described: sheet-view.tsx:1323-1333 (remote-change subscribe) -> scheduleRemoteSync (1199-1205) -> runRemoteSync (1173-1197) -> Spreadsheet.reloadDimensions (spreadsheet.ts:103-105) -> Worksheet.reloadDimensions (view/worksheet.ts:5224-5247), which reloads dimensions/styles/merges/freeze/filter/hidden/pivot and re-resolves anchors but never clears the copy buffer. Repo-wide grep shows clearCopyBuffer has only three callers — sheet.ts:1345 (shiftCells), sheet.ts:1562 (moveCells) and view/worksheet.ts:5118 (Escape) — and copyBuffer is assigned only at sheet.ts:2224/2238/2259/2381; none of these is reachable from the remote-sync chain, and the Sheet instance is created once in Spreadsheet.initialize (spreadsheet.ts:93-97) so it is not recreated on a remote change. The invariant is asserted by the code under review itself (sheet.ts:2216-2225: 'every edit that renumbers the cells it snapshotted ... must call this'), and Sheet.paste (sheet.ts:2331-2382) computes deltaRow/deltaCol and planPasteMerges from the snapshotted plain-ref sourceRange with no staleness check, so a local paste after a remote row/col insert or reorder relocates from stale coordinates and re-creates merged blocks at the wrong place. In-lane for blast radius (invariant another path violates, guard/contract bypass outside the diff); major impact stands.

finding.evidence: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:514 `setFreezePane(frozenRows, frozenCols)` writes the new freeze position with no check against `this.merges`, so freezing row N under an existing A(N):A(N+1) block creates exactly the state the diff now refuses on paste (`merge-paste-frozen`) and drag-move (`merge-move-frozen`). Same hole at sheet.ts:1327-1371: `shiftMergeMap` translates the merge map and then the freeze region is grown (`this.frozenRows = frozen + count`, sheet.ts:1350-1356) or shrunk (sheet.ts:1360-1368) without re-checking whether a block now spans the boundary. Reachable UI entry points: view/worksheet.ts:467 `setFreezePane`, the freeze-drag handlers at view/worksheet.ts:1384/1389 and the header menu at view/worksheet.ts:2974/2976, plus remote writes through packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:1146. docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:277 states the invariant flatly ("Merges that cross freeze pane boundaries are disallowed"), and the new code's own comments say the renderer assumes it when painting a frozen pane and the body from a single block — so the guard the diff adds is only half the enforcement. verdict.reason: The finding asserts that `Sheet.setFreezePane` and the freeze adjustment in the row/column insert-delete path write freeze positions "with no check against `this.merges`". Both assertions are false in this repository. `setFreezePane` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:523-528) passes its arguments through `snapFreezePastMerges` (sheet.ts:536-560), which iterates `this.merges` and pushes each boundary past any straddling block, looping until stable, before assigning and persisting. The shift path applies the identical snap after `shiftMergeMap` and after the grow/shrink adjustments (sheet.ts:1422-1427), persisting when changed (sheet.ts:1428-1433); the comment at sheet.ts:1419-1421 names precisely the state the finding says is unhandled. Every entry point the finding cites as reachable funnels into the guarded model method: view/worksheet.ts:467-471, the drag handlers at view/worksheet.ts:1384/1389, the header menu at view/worksheet.ts:2974/2976, and view/spreadsheet.ts:118-120 all call `sheet.setFreezePane`. `yorkie-store.ts:1146` is the store-level sink the model calls after snapping (sheet.ts:527, 1432), not an alternate producer. The only unsnapped write is `loadFreezePane` (sheet.ts:565-569), which merely reloads a value already snapped on write and is not the site the finding names. Code not present as described.

finding.summary: Both view paste paths stopped clearing the copy buffer, so `copyBuffer` now lives indefinitely — but no structural edit invalidates or shifts it, so a later paste relocates from a stale source range and stale merge snapshot
finding.evidence: `copyBuffer = undefined` now only happens in `clearCopyBuffer` (sheet.ts:2141, reached solely from the Escape keybinding at packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5118) and on a consumed cut (sheet.ts:2286). Nothing in `insertRows`/`deleteRows` (`shiftMergeMap`, sheet.ts:1327) or `moveCells` (sheet.ts:1516) shifts or drops `copyBuffer.sourceRange` / `copyBuffer.merges`. After copy → insert rows → Ctrl+V (clipboard text unchanged), `paste` still takes the internal branch and computes `deltaRow/deltaCol` (sheet.ts:2250) and `planPasteMerges`' destination range from a source range that no longer describes the data, mis-relocating formulas and applying a stale merge layout. The marching-ants overlay at packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5600 renders the same stale `getCopyRange()` indefinitely. Previously the view cleared the buffer right after each paste, which bounded this window to a single paste.

verdict.reason: The finding's central factual claim is false. `clearCopyBuffer()` is not reached "solely from the Escape keybinding": it is called by `shiftCells` at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1345 (before `store.shiftCells`) and by `moveCells` at sheet.ts:1562 (before `store.moveCells`). `insertRows`/`deleteRows`/`insertColumns`/`deleteColumns` (sheet.ts:1289-1316) are thin wrappers over `shiftCells`, and `moveRows`/`moveColumns` (sheet.ts:1321-1330) over `moveCells`, so every structural edit named in the finding drops the buffer. The `clearCopyBuffer` doc comment (sheet.ts:2217-2225) states this contract explicitly. Consequently the claimed repro — copy → insert rows → Ctrl+V — cannot take the internal branch at sheet.ts:2331 (`copyBuffer` is undefined), so no stale `deltaRow/deltaCol` (2339-2340) or stale `planPasteMerges` snapshot (2347-2354) is used; the paste falls through to the plain-TSV branch at 2390. The same clearing also removes the marching-ants overlay, since `getCopyRange()` (2206) reads `copyBuffer?.sourceRange`. The early returns in `moveCells` (1537, 1543, 1556) are no-op/refusal paths that write nothing, so they leave no stale state. The only uncleared mutation is `moveRangeTo` (2758), which relocates contents rather than renumbering coordinates and is not the path this finding describes.
